bias.en: Bearish · basing above the Jul 17 low
bias.zh: 偏空 · 在 7 月 17 日低点上方筑底

read.en: Sandisk slipped 0.4% on Oct 20 to $1,365.38, trading between $1,330.51 and $1,388.88. It is level with the falling 5-day average ($1,366.8), below the falling 10-day ($1,468.7), 30-day ($1,628.1) and 100-day ($1,639.4), and above the rising 200-day ($1,221.8). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 2 and is below zero, with the histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 6 ($1,557.86), and RSI is 36.

The close held above the $1,325 Jul 17 low for a second session, while the high again stalled below the $1,401 Oct 13–14 lows. Resistance is $1,401, then $1,470 (former floor, 10-day average) and $1,558 (SAR). Support is $1,325, then $1,276 (Oct 15 low) and $1,222 (200-day). A close above $1,401 would target $1,470; a close below $1,276 would open $1,222.
read.zh: 收盘连续第二个交易日守在 $1,325 的 7月17日低点上方，但盘中高点再度受阻于 $1,401 的 10月13–14日低点下方。阻力为 $1,401，其次 $1,470（前期底部、10 日均线）和 $1,558（SAR）。支撑为 $1,325，其次 $1,276（10月15日低点）和 $1,222（200 日均线）。若收盘站上 $1,401，下一目标看 $1,470；若收盘跌破 $1,276，下一目标看 $1,222。
